column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 early seasonal / Michette route (recovered)

column2: Speaking of spring flowers... $$ペンペン草$$, of course?!
What a weird name for one of the $$春の七草$$!
Speaking of summer flowers...
A $$ヘチマ$$, of course...!
You can make skin lotion and scrubbers from them, and something about that shape just makes me happy whenever I look at it!
If we're talking fall flowers... $$まんじゅしゃげ$$??
They grow next to graves a lot, you know...!
Flowers that bloom even in winter...
$$クロッカス$$ and $$ヒヤシンス$$, maybe? Hey, did you know that?!
G-good morning... Spring makes you sleepy somehow...
Mmm! The spring breeze feels so good!
We'd better work hard at your $$リハビリ$$ today too!
Mornin'! All right, today we're gonna work hard at...
Taking a nap!
Morning! Looks like it'll be hot today too...
Maybe I'll nap in the shade?!
G-good morning...
In fall I always eat too much, then of course I get sleepy...
Morning! It's getting cold, so let's start getting ready for winter!
Morning! Doesn't it feel like it might snow today?
It's so cold I don't wanna get out of bed!
Every single day is so cooold!!
Spring is next, but... when is it coming?! I can't waaaait!
Good work. It's hot again today, huh?
Hey, if you want... wanna splash around in the water with me?
Of course, you'll hold $$カイン$$ so he doesn't get wet!
Play in the water!
Don't play in the water!
Yeah... you're still in the middle of $$リハビリ$$...
Ahh!! You touched my chest just now!!
Pay up! Money!!
A $$台風$$! We have to fix the roof leak, quick!
S-sorry!
I made you overdo it when you're still recovering...
But...
Having you here made me feel so much safer...
If I were alone... I'd still be freezing...
No, I'm not cold. I'm fine...
Just being with you makes me feel warm deep inside...
But scoot a little closer...!
(If only we could stay like this...)
(together forever...)
Pant... pant... I-I feel a little feverish...
Yesterday was sooo awful, I thought I was gonna die!
You stayed with me all night, right?! S-sorry...
Th-thanks... I think I'm okay now...
But don't go out alone anymore, okay?!
Heehee! Do you remember what day it is?
Ta-daaaaa!!
Here! Happy $$誕生日$$!!
Hey, hey...! I tried cooking something myself for once!
Ta-da-da-daaaaa!!
Well?! Will you try it...?!
Pant... pant...
Aaagh... my stomach... it hurts so bad!!
Pant... pant... I-I feel kinda sick...
W-what are you looking at...?
$$ミシェット$$ is gone!!
A-are you okay?!
You've only been awake for a week, and you're already getting up...
Don't push yourself... You don't look back to normal yet.
A-and there's one important thing I need to ask you...
This is important, so don't ever forget it!
You've lost your $$記憶$$ of this $$世界$$...
and you aren't used to how things work in this $$世界$$ yet, right?
So until I can feel safe letting you leave the house,
I need you to promise never to go outside the fence on your own!!
Got it? You absolutely cannot go outside on your own!!
It's a promise between you, me, and $$カイン$$!!
Hey, you...!
Do you remember what day it is?
